situations.title: 무반응 환자 초기 인지
situations.tagline: Nurse, this patient isn't responding — I just found him like this!
situations.brief: 무반응 환자의 반응·호흡·맥박을 신속히 확인하고 상황을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: Sir, can you hear me? Open your eyes!
He's not responding — checking for breathing and a pulse.
No pulse — I'm calling a code and starting compressions.
goals: 심정지 여부를 판단하고 초기 대응을 개시한다

situations.title: 응급코드 호출·역할 배정
situations.tagline: Code Blue, bed 4 — what do you need me to do?
situations.brief: 코드블루를 호출하고 도착한 팀원에게 역할을 명확히 배정하세요.
keyPhrases: I need you on compressions — start now.
You take the airway and bag him.
Someone grab the crash cart and record the time.

situations.title: 흉부압박 기본 수행
situations.tagline: Am I pushing hard enough? Tell me if I'm doing this right.
situations.brief: 흉부압박의 위치·깊이·속도를 확인하고 2분마다 교대를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Push hard and fast in the center of the chest.
Aim for at least two inches deep, a hundred a minute.
Let's switch compressors after this cycle to stay strong.

situations.title: BVM 환기 협조
situations.tagline: The mask keeps leaking — the chest isn't rising much.
situations.brief: 기도개방과 마스크 밀착을 조정해 효과적인 BVM 환기를 협조하세요.
keyPhrases: Tilt the head back and lift the chin to open the airway.
Use a two-handed seal — I'll squeeze the bag.
Watch for the chest to rise with each breath.

situations.title: 제세동 패드 부착 안전
situations.tagline: Pads are on — should I clear everyone?
situations.brief: 제세동 패드를 부착하고 방전 전 클리어 콜아웃으로 안전을 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Place the pads right of the sternum and below the left armpit.
I'm clear, you're clear, everybody clear!
Make sure no one is touching the bed or the patient.
goals: 방전 전 안전 클리어를 확실히 콜아웃한다

situations.title: 제세동 가능 리듬(VF/pVT) 판단
situations.tagline: Rhythm check — it's fibrillating, right?
situations.brief: 리듬 분석 후 제세동 가능 리듬을 판단하고 충전·즉시 제세동을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop compressions for a rhythm check.
That's V-fib — charge to 200 and clear.
Shock delivered, resume compressions immediately.

situations.title: 무수축/PEA 대응
situations.tagline: It's asystole — no shock, right?
situations.brief: 무수축/PEA에서 제세동 대신 압박과 에피네프린을 우선하도록 팀을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: This rhythm isn't shockable — keep compressions going.
Give epinephrine one milligram now.
Continue high-quality CPR and reassess in two minutes.

situations.title: 가역적 원인(H's&T's) 점검
situations.tagline: What could be causing this — any reversible cause we're missing?
situations.brief: 팀과 함께 가역적 원인(H's&T's)을 브레인스토밍하고 점검하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's run through the H's and T's.
Could this be hypoxia, low potassium, or a tension pneumo?
Any history of clots, overdose, or bleeding?

situations.title: 정맥로/골내로 확보 소통
situations.tagline: I can't get a vein — should I go for an IO?
situations.brief: 정맥로 확보 실패 시 골내로 전환을 신속히 소통하고 확보를 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Two IV attempts failed — switching to an IO now.
IO is in the tibia and flushing well.
Access is secured, ready for medications.
goals: 정맥로 실패 시 골내로 전환을 신속히 결정한다

situations.title: ROSC 후 초기 안정화
situations.tagline: We've got a pulse back — what's our next move?
situations.brief: ROSC 직후 활력을 재사정하고 목표혈압 유지를 위한 안정화를 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: We have ROSC — recheck a full set of vitals.
Let's keep the systolic above 90 and support the airway.
Get a twelve-lead and prepare to move to the ICU.
goals: 목표혈압 유지를 위한 초기 안정화를 수행한다

situations.title: 소생 중 SBAR 리더 보고
situations.tagline: Give me a quick rundown — where are we in this code?
situations.brief: 소생 경과·투약·리듬을 SBAR로 리더에게 요약 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Down about eight minutes, three rounds of CPR so far.
Two shocks delivered, epi given twice, last dose four minutes ago.
Current rhythm is still V-fib, no ROSC yet.
goals: 현재 리듬과 다음 조치를 명확히 전달한다

situations.title: 가족 입회 소생 지원
situations.tagline: That's my husband — please tell me what you're doing to him!
situations.brief: 소생에 입회한 가족 곁에서 진행 상황을 설명하며 정서적으로 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: The team is doing everything they can for him right now.
I'll stay with you and explain what's happening.
You can stand here where he can hear your voice.
goals: 소생 진행 상황을 가족에게 이해되게 설명한다

situations.title: 목격자 CPR 이력 인수
situations.tagline: We started CPR about ten minutes ago and gave one shock with the AED.
situations.brief: EMS로부터 다운타임·투약·목격자 CPR 이력을 인수받아 정리하세요.
keyPhrases: What was the down time before CPR started?
How many shocks and medications were given in the field?
Was the arrest witnessed, and by whom?

situations.title: 압박 질 피드백 대응
situations.tagline: The monitor says our compressions are too shallow — fix it.
situations.brief: 압박 질 피드백(깊이·과환기)에 따라 실시간으로 수행을 교정하세요.
keyPhrases: Push deeper — at least two inches every time.
Let the chest fully recoil between compressions.
Slow the bagging — you're ventilating too fast.

situations.title: 저체온 심정지 연장 소생
situations.tagline: He was pulled from the icy lake — how long do we keep going?
situations.brief: 저체온 심정지에서 재가온 전까지 사망을 확정하지 않고 소생을 연장하세요.
keyPhrases: He's not dead until he's warm and dead.
Keep compressions going while we actively rewarm him.
Space out the medications until his core temperature rises.
goals: 저체온 심정지의 연장 소생 원칙을 적용한다

situations.title: 고칼륨혈증 심정지 표적치료
situations.tagline: He's a dialysis patient who missed his session — could it be potassium?
situations.brief: 고칼륨혈증 심정지를 의심하고 칼슘·인슐린 등 표적치료를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Missed dialysis makes hyperkalemia very likely.
Give calcium to protect the heart right now.
Push insulin with dextrose to shift the potassium.

situations.title: 임산부 심정지 자궁 좌측 전위
situations.tagline: She's about 34 weeks — someone displace that uterus!
situations.brief: 임산부 심정지에서 자궁 좌측 전위를 수행하고 응급제왕절개에 대비하세요.
keyPhrases: Manually displace the uterus to the left.
Call OB and neonatal — prepare for a perimortem C-section.
Keep compressions high on the sternum and continuous.
goals: 임산부 심정지에서 자궁 좌측 전위를 시행한다

situations.title: 아나필락시스성 심정지
situations.tagline: She reacted to the antibiotic and coded within minutes — her face is swollen.
situations.brief: 아나필락시스성 심정지에서 에피네프린 정주와 기도부종 대응을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: This is anaphylactic arrest — give IV epinephrine now.
Run large-volume fluids wide open.
Prepare for a difficult airway with all that swelling.

situations.title: ROSC 후 재정지 반복
situations.tagline: We got him back but he's arresting again — third time now.
situations.brief: ROSC 후 반복 재정지 환자에 대해 재소생과 이송 결정을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: He re-arrested — restart compressions immediately.
Let's find and fix why he keeps losing his pulse.
We may need urgent transfer to the cath lab.

situations.title: 소생 중단·사망 고지
situations.tagline: He has a DNR — the family is asking us to stop.
situations.brief: DNR·팀 합의에 따라 소생 중단을 조율하고 임종 과정을 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: We've confirmed his wishes not to be resuscitated.
The team agrees it's time to focus on his comfort.
I'm so sorry — take all the time you need with him.
goals: DNR와 팀 합의에 따라 소생 중단을 조율한다

situations.title: 외상성 심정지 특수 대응
situations.tagline: He was hit by a car — no pulse, and his chest looks awful.
situations.brief: 외상성 심정지에서 긴장성 기흉·출혈 등 가역 원인을 동시에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Traumatic arrest — decompress both sides of the chest.
Control the bleeding and start massive transfusion.
Compressions matter less than fixing the cause here.
goals: 외상성 심정지의 가역 원인을 동시에 대응한다
